policy: Original criteria that literally require supplier, fabricated-unit, installed-vehicle, chamber or environmental evidence remain physical acceptance items. Their prehardware engineering status is qualification-only when no further design change is justified.

gates.description: Pinned KiCad 9.0.9 native refill/ERC/DRC/export flow completed with zero findings for the exact candidate; matched netlist, manufacturing outputs and model set are preserved.
gates.reopen: Any CAD, BOM, stackup or manufacturing-source mutation.

gates.description: Pinned Arduino/core/NimBLE target build produced verified ELF/BIN outputs. Release behavior remains receive-only on CAN.
gates.reopen: Any firmware, build-profile, dependency or release-feature mutation.

gates.description: I25 replaces the stale residual-filled ~4.8 W release source with the coupled 2.940859375 W release profile. Existing-cooling maxima are 101.6503 C at 0.50 mm and 107.2667 C at 0.25 mm; convergence is not claimed and a one-step 5.6163 C discretization allowance yields a 112.8830 C board-region screening bound. C02 cooling is not adopted.
gates.qualification: Verify <=0.45 A sustained release load, >=80% effective conversion efficiency or equivalent losses, <=85 C immediate air outside U201, and temperature behavior at upper input/worst representative workload.
gates.reopen: I25 release-profile/environment violation or failed thermal qualification gate.

gates.description: Finite regulator, rail, startup, transient and oil models are retained as conservative source-bound engineering envelopes. Unpublished control/die behavior is not asserted as known.
gates.qualification: Correlate input/current/rails, startup/reset and oil transfer on the fabricated unit.
gates.reopen: Measured behavior exceeds the controlled model envelope.

gates.description: Complete 14,400-case CAN branch family settles within 1% by 137.600 ns versus representative 1.600 us sampling; sample receiver voltage remains >=1.495510 V for a 1.5 V source and DC ratio >=0.997006499. The 196 repeated 0.9 V crossings are confined to deliberate 2 ns source-edge cases, last <=5.2625 ns below 0.9 V, with zero repeated 0.5 V crossings. R301 remains DNP and firmware TX-disabled.
gates.qualification: Confirm installed fused switched feed/return, controlled harness exit/length allocation, actual vehicle traffic and absence of repeatable branch-attributable CAN errors.
gates.reopen: Installed geometry exceeds allocation, repeatable CAN corruption/error counts correlate with the branch, or CAN transmission is enabled.

gates.description: Exact Adafruit 851/960 products are bound. The mated route passes 776 modeled checks, retains >=16.421 mm RF metal-to-ESP32 antenna-region spacing, and has a 28 ohm complete bias-path resistance budget at 25 mA from the 3.0 V/2.3 V endpoints. The 851 published +60 C limit is lower than the board bulk-air envelope and is therefore an installation-zone requirement, not a PCB thermal requirement.
gates.qualification: Keep the 851 local environment <=60 C; inspect supplied SMA center contact and miniature plug/retention; confirm antenna bias >=2.3 V under representative load and module-current limits.
gates.reopen: Supplied interface differs from receiving envelope or installed adapter environment exceeds 60 C without relocation/protection.

gates.description: The controlled fabrication construction, current via-fill/cap set, stackup and local F101 handling are documented; supplier lot/process acceptance cannot be manufactured from desktop evidence.
gates.qualification: Confirm exact current files/process with JLC and reject or impact-review any deviation in stackup, copper, via fill/cap, mask or assembly process.
gates.reopen: Supplier proposes a design-relevant process deviation.

gates.description: CAD continuity/isolation and population intent are desktop-closed. Physical plating, solder, crimps, contacts and population identity are first-article observations.
gates.qualification: Perform current-netlist continuity/isolation, crimp/pull, population and identity checks.
gates.reopen: A repeatable as-built discrepancy indicates a design/package/process defect rather than workmanship.

gates.description: Current RF/return/keepout and bounded coupling analyses are sufficient for prehardware geometry release. Radiated behavior, nonlinear clamp response and installed coexistence are not claimed.
gates.qualification: Correlate installed GPS C/N0, BLE link behavior, ADC/CAN coupling and accessible-port ESD behavior.
gates.reopen: Repeatable installed RF/EMC/ESD failure exceeds the controlled acceptance plan.

gates.description: For the adopted configuration, 153 model set, 1,154 populated-stack checks, 776 revised 851 mated checks and 37 probe approaches pass declared envelopes; minimum modeled R408/T03 clearance is 0.120 mm. C02 cooler structural questions are contingency-only because C02 is not adopted.
gates.qualification: Verify received component/cable dimensions, enclosure fit, strain relief/retention and installed clearances against the controlled envelope.
gates.reopen: Actual receiving/install geometry lies outside the controlled envelope.

gates.description: Actual oil response, GPS availability, phone/OS behavior, sustained operation and environmental performance are physical system observations; desktop modeling is exhausted for release design.
gates.qualification: Execute the source-bound acceptance plan on fabricated hardware and vehicle/phone environment.
gates.reopen: A failed physical gate demonstrates a design deficiency outside the bounded prediction.

prehardware_design_statement: No gate above currently recommends a schematic, PCB, firmware, mechanical or release-profile source change before fabrication. Remaining observations are fixed qualification gates or contingency-only work.
